instruction: I'm working on a Ubuntu system. Can you set the default music player to VLC?

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting VLC as default audio/music player. Evaluator checks xdg-mime settings for audio MIME types to verify vlc.desktop is registered. Similar complexity to original task but targets audio instead of video.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator semantically and logically verifies the instruction correctly
Getter extracts default audio player by querying xdg-mime for comprehensive set of audio MIME types (aac, flac, mp3, mpeg, ogg, opus, wav, webm, etc.) - semantically correct for 'music player'
Getter uses Counter to return most common default application - reasonable approach for handling multiple MIME type registrations
Metric check_include_exclude correctly verifies vlc.desktop is present in result using substring matching
Parameter handling is correct: metric uses 'rules' parameter name which properly receives the rules dict from get_rule() when expected.type='rule'
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires (VLC as default music/audio player)
Practically feasible: xdg-mime is the standard Ubuntu mechanism for default applications, no postconfig needed as this is persistent system state
No logical edge case issues: handles empty results by returning 'unknown', robust implementation
